The app needs location permission to read your position once. It is only used to calculate prayer times and the Qibla direction, and it never leaves your phone. GPS works without internet, but the first fix can take a minute or two; go outdoors or near a window if it is slow.

Fajr 18°, Isha 17°. Widely used in Europe, the Far East and parts of America.
Fajr 19.5°, Isha 17.5°. Used in much of Africa and the Middle East.
Fajr 18°, Isha 18°. Used in Pakistan, Bangladesh, India and Afghanistan.
Fajr 18.5°, Isha 90 minutes after Maghrib. Used in Saudi Arabia. In Ramadan the official Isha is 120 minutes after Maghrib; this is not applied automatically.
Fajr 18.2°, Isha 18.2°. Used in the United Arab Emirates.
Fajr and Isha 18° with seasonal adjustments. Used by some communities in North America and the UK.
Fajr 15°, Isha 15°. Used by the Islamic Society of North America.
Fajr 18°, Isha 90 minutes after Maghrib. Used in Qatar.
Fajr 20°, Isha 18°. In our checks, Malaysia\'s official (JAKIM) Fajr was 10 minutes later than this method.
Fajr 18°, Isha 17°, with adjustments that approximate Turkey\'s official times.
Asr begins when an object\'s shadow equals its length.
Asr begins when the shadow is twice the object\'s length (later).
One-seventh of the night above 48° latitude; middle of the night elsewhere.
Fajr no earlier, and Isha no later, than the middle of the night.
Fajr no earlier than the last seventh of the night; Isha no later than the first seventh.
Limits based on the Fajr and Isha angles (angle ÷ 60 of the night).
No single method is right for every community. Choose the one your local mosque uses.

Far from the equator the sun may not go low enough for the usual Fajr and Isha angles, especially in summer. These rules set a limit. Where the sun does not rise or set at all, times cannot be calculated.

This bearing is measured from true (geographic) north. An ordinary magnetic compass points to magnetic north, which can differ by several degrees depending on where you are.
The compass sensor stopped sending readings. Leave this screen and come back to restart it.
This device does not have a magnetic sensor, so a live compass is not possible. Use the Qibla bearing above with a separate compass, remembering that a compass shows magnetic north.
Hold the phone flat (or upright with the screen facing you), away from metal and magnets. Turn until the gold Kaaba marker is at the top, under the green pointer.

Strong magnetic interference detected. Move away from magnets, metal objects, speakers, laptops and magnetic phone cases.
Phone compasses can be disturbed by magnets, metal, phone cases and electronics. If in doubt, check the direction against a mosque or another reliable source.

Sets a one-off short Azan through the real alarm system. Lock your phone and wait to check it plays.
Things that can stop an Azan

Android cannot guarantee an alarm in every situation. The Azan may not be heard if: the alarm volume is at zero; Do Not Disturb is set to block alarms; the phone is switched off; permissions above are turned off; the phone maker\'s battery saver closes the app; or another app or a phone call is using the audio. An Azan that was missed (for example because the phone was off) is not played late.

Add or remove minutes to match your local mosque. For example, add 10 minutes to Fajr to match Malaysia\'s official (JAKIM) timetable. Adjustments also move the Azan alarms. Sunrise is shown for information only.
Version, privacy, data sources and limitations
Prayer times, Azan alarms and a Qibla compass that work without internet. Everything is calculated on this phone.

• No account, no advertising, no analytics and no tracking.
• The app has no internet permission, so it cannot send anything anywhere.
• Your location is only used to calculate prayer times and the Qibla direction. It is stored on this phone and never leaves it.
• Location permission is only asked for if you tap "Use current location". You can always choose a city or type coordinates instead.
• App data is excluded from cloud backup and phone-to-phone transfer.

• Location (only if you use GPS): to find your position once.
• Notifications: to show the Azan notification with a Stop button.
• Alarms and reminders: to start the Azan at the exact minute.
• Run at startup, background playback and keep awake: to restore alarms after a restart and to play the Azan with the screen off.

• Prayer times: Adhan library by Batoul Apps (MIT licence).
• City list: GeoNames (geonames.org), Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.
• True north correction: the World Magnetic Model built into Android.
• Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and AndroidX (Apache licence 2.0).

• Prayer times are calculated, not copied from a mosque. Methods differ between communities; check against your local mosque and use the minute adjustments if needed.
• Where the sun does not rise or set (polar regions), times cannot be calculated.
• A phone compass can be disturbed by magnets, metal and electronics.
• Android cannot guarantee that an alarm will sound in every situation (see Prayer alarms).

Samsung: Settings, Apps, Universal Azan & Qibla, Battery, choose \"Unrestricted\". Also check Settings, Battery, Background usage limits, and make sure the app is not in \"Sleeping apps\" or \"Deep sleeping apps\".
Xiaomi, Redmi or POCO: Settings, Apps, Manage apps, Universal Azan & Qibla. Turn on \"Autostart\" and set Battery saver to \"No restrictions\".
Huawei or Honor: Settings, Battery, App launch, Universal Azan & Qibla. Choose \"Manage manually\" and turn on all three options.
OPPO, realme or OnePlus: Settings, Battery, then find Universal Azan & Qibla and allow background activity. Also turn on \"Auto launch\" (or \"Allow auto launch\") if your phone has it.
vivo or iQOO: Settings, Battery, Background power consumption management, Universal Azan & Qibla, choose \"Allow\". Also turn on \"Auto start\" in the app\'s settings.

If an Azan does not play: in your phone\'s settings, open Apps, Universal Azan & Qibla, Battery, and choose \"Unrestricted\" (the name varies by phone). Then use \"Test alarm in 1 minute\" with the screen locked.
